explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 70 configurations over 8 sweeps (topology, ep-off, drafting-depth, batch-caps, moe-collective, kv-and-engram, cudagraph, routing-and-prefix-cache), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 32 GPUs.
4x TP8 + EP (max seqs 256 · batch tokens 32,768), from the batch-caps sweep, reached 38.23 tok/s/accelerator (1223.3 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 96 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
4x TP8 + EP (max seqs 256 · batch tokens 32,768) at concurrency 96. 36 of 280 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: Wide TP8 instances should win at the SLO, since narrow tp pays more per-step latency than the extra replicas buy back.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP at 26.94 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: topology

prose: Replicating all 128 experts should cost KV room and throughput against the EP twins in topology.
Measured: no configuration in this sweep held the SLOs at any tested load.
sections.title: Sweep: ep-off

prose: Deeper dspark drafts should add tok/s, but the 20ms ITL bound should cap K lower on narrow tp than on TP8.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP at 24.21 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: drafting-depth

prose: max_num_seqs should bind on TP8 ranks and not on TP2, while a small token cap trades throughput for tail ITL on both.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (max seqs 256 · batch tokens 32,768) at 38.23 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 96).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-caps

prose: Routed all-to-all backends should only pay once EP spans nodes, and hurt on narrow tp where buffers crowd KV.
Measured: no configuration in this sweep held the SLOs at any tested load.
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: Moving Engram tables into HBM should only pay when gmu leaves KV room for them, and cost more on narrow tp.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP at 26.94 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-and-engram

prose: FULL-family capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent and NONE should collapse.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (graph capture full+piecewise) at 27.06 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph

prose: prefix-affinity should only beat random with caching on, and the gap should widen from 2 to 4 instances.
Measured: no configuration in this sweep held the SLOs at any tested load.
sections.title: Sweep: routing-and-prefix-cache
